acf.desc_episodes: As a seasoned business and technology leader with over 30 years of experience, Dan has a track record of driving growth in insurance companies. His expertise lies in operational delivery, spearheading innovation and digital agendas, and assisting C-Level leadership in new business development. Dan's technology leadership services are tailored to help businesses navigate digital transformation and achieve growth.
